scenes.say: True or false? Sugar free cookies have no carbs.
Myth! They're still made with flour, and flour is a carb.
scenes.headline: STILL HAS CARBS

scenes.say: Check the total carbs on the label, not just the sugar.
scenes.headline: CHECK THE LABEL

scenes.say: Sugar free doesn't mean carb free.
scenes.headline: SUGAR-FREE ≠ CARB-FREE
